literature.headline_zh: 季节性流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期季节性流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 与此 抗病毒药物 概况一致,在 NSCLC 中检测到甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 转录物,并与不良预后和复发相关。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10703221/v1]
结果表明,似然函数沿着山脊平坦,这意味着改变报告率 ρ 和初始感染大小 i 0 对对数似然的影响最小。在合成网格上,有界后验翻转了 27% 的单元格中的插件操作,损失了 12% 的预言机价值。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11350156/v1]
该研究鉴定了 18 种基因型,包括 11 种新型重配体,并发现几种基因型是西班牙独有的,随着 H1N1pdm09 不断从人类引入,产生了重配基因型。 [10.1093/ve/veag067]
研究结果表明,谱系富集主要发生在同步共感染期间,此时多个病毒 基因组 占据同一细胞,并且病毒输出增加。 [10.1038/s44319-026-00968-1]

该研究鉴定出 19 种基因型,其中完全源自 EA 的基因型 G1 占 基因组 的 57.0%,并且几乎在整个研究期间都被检测到。许多重配基因型在短时间内被检测到,显示出长期的持续性。基因型组成因地理位置而异,重配基因型在亚洲丰富,而主要源自 EA 的基因型在欧洲更为常见。在考虑抽样强度后,定向活猪贸易是迁徙预测因素中最有力的支持。16 个候选血凝素密码子显示出情景多样化选择的证据,大多数候选 HA1 残基映射到靠近抗原区域的球状头的暴露区域。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11044325/v1]

news.lead_zh: 本期季节性流感病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 该报告概述了英格兰流感、RSV 和 COVID-19 活动的现状,指出流感活动稳定、RSV 混合趋势以及 COVID-19 的低水平循环。它还讨论了 疫苗 吸收数据和测试方法。 [news-ca1c4a3428773cd3]
FDA 批准 Moderna 的 mRNA 季节性流感 疫苗(mFLUSIVA)用于 50 岁以上成人(N2)。该批准最初被推迟,但在 Moderna 承诺进行更多研究 (N15) 后重新考虑。 [news-ff17095c95e1854f]
甲型 H1N1 流感加剧了美国绝大多数病例。 [news-c3edd00cc5ce3d59]
科索沃启动季节性流感 疫苗接种 运动,前四天就有 600 名公民接种了疫苗,其中主要是老年人和慢性病患者。该活动被推迟了三周。 [news-f9afae75aa914783]
2026-2027 年流感 疫苗 已更新,以更好地匹配本季度预计传播的流感病毒,包括更新的 H3N2 成分(N3、N13、N14、N43)。 [news-9dd2722fa6cb7c16]

key_findings_en: The report outlines the current status of influenza, RSV, and COVID-19 activity in England, noting stable influenza activity, mixed trends for RSV, and low-level circulation of COVID-19. It also discusses vaccine uptake data and testing methodologies. [news-ca1c4a3428773cd3]

The FDA approved Moderna's mRNA seasonal flu vaccine, mFLUSIVA, for use in adults over 50 (N2). This approval was initially delayed but was reconsidered after Moderna committed to additional studies (N15). [news-ff17095c95e1854f]
Influenza A H1N1 is fueling the vast majority of cases in the U.S. [news-c3edd00cc5ce3d59]

Seasonal flu vaccination campaign started in Kosovo, with 600 citizens vaccinated in the first four days, primarily among the elderly and those with chronic diseases. The campaign was delayed by three weeks. [news-f9afae75aa914783]
The 2026–2027 flu vaccine has been updated to better match the influenza viruses expected to circulate this season, including an updated H3N2 component (N3, N13, N14, N43). [news-9dd2722fa6cb7c16]

papers.title: Differentiating Avian and Seasonal Influenza Viruses in Wastewater by Digital PCR.
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5Nx) viruses, particularly clade 2.3.4.4b, pose substantial global health risks. We combined and piloted 2 duplex reverse transcription digital PCRs to discriminate between avian and seasonal influenza viruses in wastewater. This approach enabled rapid, strain-specific detection to reduce ambiguity in environmental surveillance for influenza viruses.

papers.title: Auditing model-based antiviral recommendations: a decision-relevance diagnostic for seasonal influenza surveillance
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Antiviral stockpile decisions rest on transmission models calibrated to surveillance data. Seasonal influenza surveillance records reported cases rather than infections, so the reporting rate ρ and the initial infection size i 0 enter expected counts only through their product: the likelihood is exactly flat along a ridge in (ρ, i 0 ). Standard calibration checks can pass while the recommended intervention remains unidentified. Methods We built a six-parameter SEIRS-type influenza model with negative-binomial reporting, fit neural posterior estimators to reported counts, and scored decision stability with a variance-weighted decision-relevance score (DRS), the share of the decision margin's posterior variance coming from weakly identified directions. A scale-invariant positive control checked the score. We audited a 192-cell synthetic grid and 204 real CDC influenza region-seasons, comparing the score with a purely geometric alternative. Results The ridge is exact: compensating i 0 across ρ's full prior range changes the single-season log-likelihood by at most 0.261. On the synthetic grid the bounded posterior flipped the plug-in action in 27% of cells, losing 12% of the oracle's value. The geometric index failed its own control arm, whereas the variance-weighted score separated the arms (0.30 vs 0.13, Fisher/Laplace geometry; 0.25 vs 0.05, neural posterior). Parameter-level non-identifiability did not predict decision instability (Spearman + 0.107, p = 0.14). On real seasons the score separated sensitive from insensitive decisions by up to several hundredfold, and seven of 204 region-seasons (3.4%) had a margin below its own posterior standard deviation, six in the 2022–2023 season. Conclusions A calibrated posterior is not sufficient evidence that a model-based recommendation is identified, and parameter-level diagnostics do not reveal when this happens. Computed from the posterior a team already holds and needing no new data, the score flags the seasons in which the recommendation would be untrustworthy; we suggest running it as a routine audit alongside calibration checks.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of identifying reliable antiviral recommendations based on seasonal influenza surveillance data, which often lacks sufficient information to distinguish between reported cases and actual infections.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved a synthetic grid of 192 cells and 204 real CDC influenza region-seasons, comparing model-based antiviral recommendations across different data scenarios.
analysis.methods: The researchers developed a six-parameter SEIRS-type influenza model with negative-binomial reporting, fitted neural posterior estimators to reported counts, and used a variance-weighted decision-relevance score (DRS) to assess decision stability.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that the likelihood function is flat along a ridge, meaning that varying the reporting rate ρ and initial infection size i 0 has minimal impact on the log-likelihood. On the synthetic grid, the bounded posterior flipped the plug-in action in 27% of cells, losing 12% of the oracle's value.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence that a calibrated posterior alone is insufficient to confirm model-based recommendations are identified, and that parameter-level non-identifiability does not necessarily lead to decision instability.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that the proposed decision-relevance score can be used as a routine audit to identify seasons where antiviral recommendations may be unreliable, thereby improving the accuracy of seasonal influenza surveillance and decision-making.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the reliance on a synthetic grid and real CDC data, which may not fully represent all influenza dynamics. The evidence strength is moderate, as the results are based on a combination of simulated and real-world data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the reliability of model-based antiviral recommendations for seasonal influenza by analyzing how surveillance data affects decision-making. The researchers developed a SEIRS-type influenza model with negative-binomial reporting and used a variance-weighted decision-relevance score (DRS) to assess decision stability. They found that the likelihood function is flat along a ridge, meaning that changes in reporting rates and initial infection sizes have minimal impact on the log-likelihood. On a synthetic grid, the bounded posterior led to changes in plug-in actions in 27% of cells, reducing the oracle's value by 12%. The study highlights that a calibrated posterior is not enough to ensure reliable recommendations and that parameter-level non-identifiability does not always predict decision instability. These findings suggest that the DRS can be used as a routine audit to flag unreliable seasons for antiviral decisions, enhancing the accuracy of seasonal influenza surveillance. However, the study's reliance on simulated and real-world data limits its generalizability, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength.

elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved a synthetic grid of 192 cells and 204 real CDC influenza region-seasons, comparing model-based antiviral recommendations across different data scenarios.
elements_en.methods: The researchers developed a six-parameter SEIRS-type influenza model with negative-binomial reporting, fitted neural posterior estimators to reported counts, and used a variance-weighted decision-relevance score (DRS) to assess decision stability.
elements_en.main_results: The results showed that the likelihood function is flat along a ridge, meaning that varying the reporting rate ρ and initial infection size i 0 has minimal impact on the log-likelihood. On the synthetic grid, the bounded posterior flipped the plug-in action in 27% of cells, losing 12% of the oracle's value.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence that a calibrated posterior alone is insufficient to confirm model-based recommendations are identified, and that parameter-level non-identifiability does not necessarily lead to decision instability.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that the proposed decision-relevance score can be used as a routine audit to identify seasons where antiviral recommendations may be unreliable, thereby improving the accuracy of seasonal influenza surveillance and decision-making.

papers.title_zh: 审计基于模型的 抗病毒药物 建议:季节性流感 监测 的决策相关性诊断
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Antiviral stockpile decisions rest on transmission models calibrated to surveillance data. Seasonal influenza surveillance records reported cases rather than infections, so the reporting rate ρ and the initial infection size i 0 enter expected counts only through their product: the likelihood is exactly flat along a ridge in (ρ, i 0 ). Standard calibration checks can pass while the recommended intervention remains unidentified. Methods We built a six-parameter SEIRS-type influenza model with negative-binomial reporting, fit neural posterior estimators to reported counts, and scored decision stability with a variance-weighted decision-relevance score (DRS), the share of the decision margin's posterior variance coming from weakly identified directions. A scale-invariant positive control checked the score. We audited a 192-cell synthetic grid and 204 real CDC influenza region-seasons, comparing the score with a purely geometric alternative. Results The ridge is exact: compensating i 0 across ρ's full prior range changes the single-season log-likelihood by at most 0.261. On the synthetic grid the bounded posterior flipped the plug-in action in 27% of cells, losing 12% of the oracle's value. The geometric index failed its own control arm, whereas the variance-weighted score separated the arms (0.30 vs 0.13, Fisher/Laplace geometry; 0.25 vs 0.05, neural posterior). Parameter-level non-identifiability did not predict decision instability (Spearman + 0.107, p = 0.14). On real seasons the score separated sensitive from insensitive decisions by up to several hundredfold, and seven of 204 region-seasons (3.4%) had a margin below its own posterior standard deviation, six in the 2022–2023 season. Conclusions A calibrated posterior is not sufficient evidence that a model-based recommendation is identified, and parameter-level diagnostics do not reveal when this happens. Computed from the posterior a team already holds and needing no new data, the score flags the seasons in which the recommendation would be untrustworthy; we suggest running it as a routine audit alongside calibration checks.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景 抗病毒药物 库存决策取决于根据 监测 数据校准的 传播 模型。季节性流感 监测 记录报告病例而不是感染情况,因此报告率 ρ 和初始感染规模 i 0 仅通过其乘积进入预期计数:可能性沿着 (ρ,i 0 ) 中的山脊完全平坦。标准校准检查可以通过,而建议的干预措施仍未确定。方法我们建立了一个具有负二项式报告的六参数SEIRS型流感模型,将神经后验估计器与报告的计数进行拟合,并使用方差加权决策相关性评分(DRS)对决策稳定性进行评分,DRS是来自弱识别方向的决策边际后验方差的份额。尺度不变的阳性对照检查了分数。我们审核了 192 个单元的合成网格和 204 个真实的 CDC 流感区域季节,将分数与纯几何替代方案进行比较。结果 岭是精确的:在 ρ 的整个先验范围内补偿 i 0 最多可将单季对数似然改变 0.261。在合成网格上,有界后验翻转了 27% 的单元格中的插件操作,损失了 12% 的预言机价值。几何指数未能达到其自己的控制臂,而方差加权得分将各臂分开(0.30 vs 0.13,Fisher/Laplace 几何;0.25 vs 0.05,神经后验)。参数级不可识别性并不能预测决策不稳定(Spearman + 0.107,p = 0.14)。在实际季节中,敏感决策与不敏感决策的得分相差高达数百倍,204 个地区季节中有 7 个 (3.4%) 的差距低于其自身的后验标准差,其中 2022-2023 年季节有 6 个。结论 校准后验不足以证明基于模型的推荐已被识别,并且参数级诊断无法揭示何时发生这种情况。根据球队已经拥有的后验计算并且不需要新数据,分数标记了推荐不可信的赛季;我们建议将其作为例行审核与校准检查一起运行。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal genomic epidemiology of Eurasian avian-like H1N1 swine influenza viruses
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Eurasian avian-like (EA) H1N1 swine influenza viruses pose a zoonotic threat, yet their genomic evolution and dissemination across Eurasia remain incompletely understood. This study investigated genotype diversity, temporal persistence, and geographic spread, and assessed the association between live-swine trade and viral migration to inform surveillance. Methods We analysed 1,703 publicly available EA H1N1 genomes sampled from 19 countries between 2009 and 2025. Lineage assignments across all eight gene segments were used to identify genotypes and describe their temporal and geographic distributions. Time-scaled Bayesian phylogenetics and discrete phylogeography were used to reconstruct evolutionary relationships and migration patterns. Generalized linear modelling assessed migration predictors, including directed live-swine trade and sampling intensity. The mixed effects model of evolution was used to detect episodic diversifying selection in hemagglutinin, followed by structural mapping of candidate residues. Results We identified 19 genotypes. The wholly EA-derived genotype G1 accounted for 57.0% of genomes and was detected across nearly the entire study period. Many reassortant genotypes carrying A(H1N1)pdm09- or triple-reassortant-derived segments were detected over short intervals, although several showed prolonged persistence. Genotype composition differed geographically, with reassortant genotypes enriched in Asia and predominantly EA-derived constellations more common in Europe. Phylogeographic reconstruction indicated asymmetric dissemination within and between Europe and Asia, with Western Europe occupying a central position in the inferred migration network. Directed live-swine trade received the strongest support among migration predictors after accounting for sampling intensity. Sixteen candidate hemagglutinin codons showed evidence of episodic diversifying selection. Most candidate HA1 residues mapped to exposed regions of the globular head near antigenic regions. Conclusions EA H1N1 evolution across Eurasia was characterized by a persistent EA genomic background, regional genotype diversification through reassortment, and spread associated with live-swine trade. These findings support integrating genomic surveillance with animal movement data to guide surveillance along trade networks and improve the detection and assessment of emerging variants of zoonotic concern.

This study investigated genotype diversity, temporal persistence, and geographic spread, and assessed the association between live-swine trade and viral migration to inform surveillance. Methods We analysed 1,703 publicly available EA H1N1 genomes sampled from 19 countries between 2009 and 2025. Lineage assignments across all eight gene segments were used to identify genotypes and describe their temporal and geographic distributions. Time-scaled Bayesian phylogenetics and discrete phylogeography were used to reconstruct evolutionary relationships and migration patterns. Generalized linear modelling assessed migration predictors, including directed live-swine trade and sampling intensity. The mixed effects model of evolution was used to detect episodic diversifying selection in hemagglutinin, followed by structural mapping of candidate residues. Results We identified 19 genotypes. The wholly EA-derived genotype G1 accounted for 57.0% of genomes and was detected across nearly the entire study period. Many reassortant genotypes carrying A(H1N1)pdm09- or triple-reassortant-derived segments were detected over short intervals, although several showed prolonged persistence. Genotype composition differed geographically, with reassortant genotypes enriched in Asia and predominantly EA-derived constellations more common in Europe. Phylogeographic reconstruction indicated asymmetric dissemination within and between Europe and Asia, with Western Europe occupying a central position in the inferred migration network. Directed live-swine trade received the strongest support among migration predictors after accounting for sampling intensity. Sixteen candidate hemagglutinin codons showed evidence of episodic diversifying selection. Most candidate HA1 residues mapped to exposed regions of the globular head near antigenic regions. Conclusions EA H1N1 evolution across Eurasia was characterized by a persistent EA genomic background, regional genotype diversification through reassortment, and spread associated with live-swine trade. These findings support integrating genomic surveillance with animal movement data to guide surveillance along trade networks and improve the detection and assessment of emerging variants of zoonotic concern.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查基因组 进化 和欧亚类禽 (EA) H1N1 猪流感病毒在欧亚大陆的传播,解决对其人畜共患病威胁和基因组 进化 的不完全了解。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 2009 年至 2025 年间来自 19 个国家的 1,703 个 EA H1N1 基因组,重点关注基因型多样性、时间持久性和地理传播,特别强调活猪贸易和病毒迁移之间的关联。
elements_zh.methods: Genotype assignments across all eight gene segments were used to identify genotypes and describe their temporal and geographic distributions. Time-scaled Bayesian phylogenetics and discrete phylogeography were employed to reconstruct evolutionary relationships and migration patterns. Generalized linear modeling assessed migration predictors,including directed live-swine trade and sampling intensity. 进化 的混合效应模型用于检测血凝素中的情景多样化选择,然后对候选残基进行结构作图。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究鉴定出 19 种基因型,其中完全源自 EA 的基因型 G1 占 基因组 的 57.0%,并且几乎在整个研究期间都被检测到。许多重配基因型在短时间内被检测到,显示出长期的持续性。基因型组成因地理位置而异,重配基因型在亚洲丰富,而主要源自 EA 的基因型在欧洲更为常见。在考虑抽样强度后,定向活猪贸易是迁徙预测因素中最有力的支持。16 个候选血凝素密码子显示出情景多样化选择的证据,大多数候选 HA1 残基映射到靠近抗原区域的球状头的暴露区域。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果支持将 基因组监测 与动物移动数据相结合,以指导 监测 沿贸易网络发展,并改进对人畜共患新出现变异的检测和评估,强调活猪贸易在病毒迁移中的作用以及通过重配实现区域基因型多样化的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究的结果可以通过将基因组数据与动物运动模式相结合,为 监测 策略提供信息,从而增强对新出现的人畜共患流感变异的检测和评估。这有助于及早识别潜在的大流行威胁并指导公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括依赖公开的 基因组、潜在的抽样偏差以及需要进一步验证已识别的候选残基。由于该研究的观察性质以及需要纵向数据来确认活猪贸易在病毒迁移中的作用,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 欧亚类禽 (EA) H1N1 猪流感病毒构成人畜共患威胁,但其基因组 进化 和在欧亚大陆的传播仍不完全清楚。本研究调查了基因型多样性、时间持久性和地理传播,并评估了活猪贸易和病毒迁移之间的关联,为 监测 提供信息。方法 我们分析了 2009 年至 2025 年间从 19 个国家采样的 1,703 个公开的 EA H1N1 基因组。所有八个基因片段的谱系分配用于识别基因型并描述其时间和地理分布。时间尺度的贝叶斯系统发育学和离散系统发育地理学被用来重建进化关系和迁移模式。广义线性模型评估了迁移预测因素,包括定向活猪贸易和采样强度。进化 的混合效应模型用于检测血凝素中的情景多样化选择,然后对候选残基进行结构作图。结果 我们鉴定出 19 种基因型。完全源自 EA 的基因型 G1 占 基因组 的 57.0%,并且几乎在整个研究期间都被检测到。许多携带 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09 或三重重配衍生片段的重配基因型在短时间内被检测到,尽管有几种重配基因型表现出长期持续性。基因型组成因地理位置而异,重配基因型在亚洲丰富,而主要源自 EA 的基因型在欧洲更为常见。系统发育地理学重建表明欧洲和亚洲内部和之间的传播不对称,西欧在推断的迁徙网络中占据中心位置。在考虑抽样强度后,定向活猪贸易在迁徙预测因素中获得了最有力的支持。十六个候选血凝素密码子显示出情景多样化选择的证据。大多数候选 HA1 残基定位到靠近抗原区域的球状头的暴露区域。结论 欧亚大陆的 EA H1N1 进化 的特点是持续的 EA 基因组背景、通过重配实现的区域基因型多样化以及与活猪贸易相关的传播。这些发现支持将 基因组监测 与动物移动数据相结合,以指导 监测 沿贸易网络发展,并改进对人畜共患问题的新变种的检测和评估。

papers.title: Intratumoral influenza A virus infection drives platinum resistance and invasive reprogramming in NSCLC
papers.abstract: Respiratory viral infections are frequent in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), yet whether intratumoral viral presence directly influences tumor behavior and therapeutic response remains unknown. Here, we identify a respiratory virus-associated drug metabolism program (REVIS-DM), predominantly expressed by tumor cells and linked to poor clinical outcome. Across multiple NSCLC cohorts, a subgroup of tumors with concurrent high REVIS-DM, interferon-stimulated gene and antiviral signatures was associated with reduced survival and increased relapse after chemotherapy. Consistent with this antiviral profile, Influenza A virus (IAV) transcripts were detected in NSCLC and associated with poor outcome and relapse. Mechanistically, IAV infection induced xenobiotic detoxification, epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, invasion, and platinum resistance in vitro and in vivo. These effects required viral sensing and NLRP3 inflammasome signaling but were independent of type I/III interferon pathways. Together, our findings establish intratumoral IAV infection as a previously unrecognized driver of tumor-cell plasticity and chemoresistance in NSCLC, revealing virus-induced metabolic vulnerabilities with potential therapeutic relevance.

Key words: lung cancer, influenza virus, drug metabolism, chemoresistance, EMT, invasion 3 Abstract Respiratory viral infections are frequent in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), yet whether intratumoral viral presence directly influences tumor behavior and therapeutic response remains unknown. Here, we identify a respiratory virus-associated drug metabolism program (REVIS-DM), predominantly expressed by tumor cells and linked to poor clinical outcome. Across multiple NSCLC cohorts, a subgroup of tumors with concurrent high REVIS- DM, interferon-stimulated gene and antiviral signatures was associated with reduced survival and increased relapse after chemotherapy. Together, our findings establish intratumoral IAV infection as a previously unrecognized driver of tumor-cell plasticity and chemoresistance in NSCLC, revealing virus- induced metabolic vulnerabilities with potential therapeutic relevance. 4 Introduction Non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with a 5-year survival rate below 15% despite major therapeutic advances, including perioperative chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and targeted therapies 1. Resistance to treatment and metastases occurrence remain the principal drivers of therapeutic failure 2 Multiple mechanisms contribute to chemoresistance, including enhanced DNA repair, epigenetic reprogramming, resistance to apoptosis, drug efflux, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) 3. Yet whether exogenous environmental factors, particularly microbial ones, can trigger or amplify such programs in the tumor cell has received limited attention. The tumor microenvironment (TME) is a critical determinant of NSCLC progression and therapeutic response 4,5. Beyond its immune composition, accumulating evidence indicates that microorganisms shape the TME and influence cancer evolution. The gut microbiota modulates responses to immunotherapy, while intratumoral lung microbiota contributes to tumor progression 6,7. Epidemiological studies further suggest that recurrent respiratory viral infections, particularly with influenza virus, increase lung cancer risk through chronic inflammation and tissue remodeling 8. In other hand, in NSCLC patients, these infections are frequent comorbidities associated with more severe disease course and viral persistence 9–11. Influenza A virus (IAV) can directly infect tumor cells and alter their phenotype 12, yet the consequences of such infections on TME features, tumor progression, and response to treatments remain poorly understood. IAV single-stranded RNA (ssRNA) is sensed by pattern recognition receptors, including TLR7, triggering NF-kB and type I/III interferon (IFN) signaling 13–15. We previously demonstrated that TLR7 is highly expressed by tumor cells within the lung TME and that its activation promotes tumor growth, metastasis, and chemoresistance 16–18. More recently, we showed that IAV infection of lung tumor-bearing mice induces sustained intratumoral viral persistence, extensive TME remodeling, and accelerated 5 tumor progression 19. Transcriptomic analysis of IAV-infected tumors identified a respiratory virus-associated signature (REVIS) enriched in genes involved in xenobiotic metabolism, detoxification, oxidative stress response, and chemoresistance 19. Here, we investigate whether IAV infection promotes chemoresistance in NSCLC through induction of such program. Integrating transcriptomic analyses of human NSCLC cohorts, intratumoral viral transcript detection, single-cell RNA sequencing, functional chemoresistance assays, siRNA and CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing, and 3D invasion models, we identify a previously unrevealed link between intratumoral IAV infection, xenobiotic metabolism, EMT-associated reprogramming, and platinum resistance. Mechanistically, we demonstrate that viral sensing and inflammasome signaling, but not canonical IFN signaling, drive this chemoresistant state, defining a novel vulnerability at the intersection of virology and oncology. 6 Methods Cell Lines Human NSCLC cell lines A549, H1355, and SK-MES, and the nonmalignant bronchial epithelial cell line Beas-2B, were obtained from ATCC. H1975, H1650, and HCC827 cells were kindly provided by S. Mouillet-Richard (Centre de Recherche des Cordeliers, Paris, France). Cells were cultured at 37°C under 5% CO2 in DMEM/F12 (Gibco, 11320033) supplemented with 10% heat-inactivated FBS (Eurobio, CVFSVF00), 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin (Gibco, 15140122), 1% L-glutamine (Gibco, 25030081), 1% Non- Essential Amino-Acid (Gibco, 11140050), 1% sodium pyruvate (Gibco, 11360070), and 1% HEPES (Gibco, 15630080). Cisplatin-resistant A549 cells, generated by long-term culture in the presence of increasing concentrations of cisplatin, were kindly provided by G. Kroemer’s laboratory (Centre de Recherche des Cordeliers, Paris, France). Murine KP lung adenocarcinoma cells derived from KrasLSL-G12D/+Trp53flox/flox tumors were kindly provided by L Menger (Institut Gustave Roussy, Paris, France). KP cells were cultured in RPMI 1640 Glutamax (Gibco, 61870036) supplemented with 10% heat-inactivated FBS, 1% penicillin/streptomycin, and 1% HEPES. Cells were used for fewer than 15 passages. All cell lines were routinely tested for mycoplasma contamination (Ozyme, MORV0011). Cell lines were not authenticated. Influenza A Virus Strains Influenza A virus (IAV) strains A/Scotland/20/74 (H3N2) and A/PR/8/34 (H1N1) were provided by J.M. Sallenave (INSERM UMR 1152, Universite Paris Cite, Paris, France). Viruses were propagated in MDCK cells and purified from culture supernatants by sucrose gradient centrifugation. 7 Reagents Cisplatin, carboplatin, oxaliplatin, vinorelbine, paclitaxel, fluorouracil, and gemcitabine were obtained from the pharmacy of Cochin hospital (Paris, France). In vitro IAV Infection For 2D cultures, A549 cells (1.5 x 105 cells/well) were infected with IAV (MOI = 1) for 2 h, washed, and cultured for the indicated times. For 3D cultures, cells were infected in suspension (1 × 105 cells/mL, MOI = 0.1) for 2 h, washed, and seeded in ultra-low attachment 96-well plates (200 cells/well) for 2-3 days. RNA Extraction and RT-qPCR RNA was extracted from cell lysates using NucleoSpin RNA plus or NucleoSpin RNA plus XS kits (Macherey-Nagel, 740984, 740990). RNA from FFPE human tumor samples was isolated using the Maxwell 16 FFPE tissue LEV Purification kit (Promega, AS1260). RNA quality and concentration were assessed using an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer. cDNA synthesis was performed using the high-capacity cDNA reverse transcription kit (Applied Biosystem, 4374966). cDNA concentration was measured using the Qubit ssDNA Assay kit (Invitrogen, Q10212). Quantitative PCR was performed using TaqMan universal master mix II (Applied Biosystems, 4440040) and TaqMan probes listed in Supplementary Table 1. Gene expression was normalized to HPRT1, and relative expression was calculated using the ΔΔCq method. Fold-change was determined by the formula: FC=2-ΔΔCq. Multiplex Gene Expression Profiling Multiplex gene expression analyses were performed using the QuantiGene Plex Gene Expression Assay (Invitrogen). Two custom panels were designed containing genes related to antiviral responses, drug detoxification, EMT, and invasion (Supplementary Tables 2,3). 8 Plates were analyzed on a Luminex FlexMap3D system. Data were normalized using housekeeping genes with Quantigene Plex software. Flow Cytometry Cells were harvested 24 h after IAV infection, washed with PBS containing 10% FBS and incubated with anti-mouse CD16/CD32 antibody (1:50; BD Pharmingen, 553142) to block Fc receptors. Cells were then stained with anti-IAV nucleoprotein (NP-FITC) antibody (Invitrogen, clone MA1-7322) following fixation and permeabilization (eBioscience, 88-8824- 00). Dead cells were excluded using Live/Dead Aqua staining (Invitrogen, L34965). Samples were acquired on a BD LSRFortessa X-20 flow cytometer (BD Biosciences) and analyzed using FlowJosoftware v10 (BD Biosciences). In vitro Chemoresistance Assays Cells (5 x 103/well) were seeded in 96-well plates and infected with IAV (MOI = 1) for 2 h. Cells were washed and treated with chemotherapeutic agents at various concentrations either immediately or 24 h postinfection. Cell viability and cytotoxicity were assessed after 48-72 h using XTT (CyQuant XTT, Invitrogen, X12223) and LDH assays (CyQuant LDH, Invitrogen, C20300), respectively. Absorbance was measured using an Infinite 200 pro microplate reader (Tecan). For fluorescence-based cell counting, cells were fixed with 4% paraformaldehyde during 15 min, stained with Hoechst 33342 (NucBlue, Invitrogen, R37605), and imaged using an Operetta CLS high-content imaging system. Cell viability was normalized to untreated controls. siRNA-Mediated Gene Silencing Cells were transfected with siRNAs (FlexiTube, Qiagen) targeting MYD88, MAVS, STAT1, or IL28RA using Lipofectamine RNAiMAX (Invitrogen, 13778150) at a final concentration of 10 μM. After 24 h, cells were cultured in fresh medium for an additional 24 h before IAV infection 9 (H3N2, MOI = 1). After 2 h of incubation, cells were washed to remove unbound viral particles. RNA was collected 24 h post-infection for RT-qPCR analysis. For chemoresistance assays, cells were treated with cisplatin (20 μM) and viability was assessed after 72 h using XTT assays. CRISPR/Cas9-Mediated IFNAR1 Knockout IFNAR1 knockout A549 cells were generated by CRISPR/Cas9 with guide sequence ACAGGAGCGAUGAGUCUGUC (Transcript ID: ENST00000270139.8; Synthego). Single- cell clones were obtained by limiting dilution. Functional IFNAR1 knockout was validated by IFN-β stimulation (100 ng/mL, 18 h) followed by ISG15 quantification. In vivo Chemoresistance Assay B6(C)/Rj-Tyrc/c mice (Janvier Labs) were subcutaneously injected with 1 x 105 KP cells. Once tumors became palpable (day 16), mice were randomized into four groups and intratumorally injected with IAV (H3N2, 150 PFU in 40μL PBS) or PBS. Mice subsequently received intratumoral cisplatin injections (100 μM, 40μL) on days 18, 21, and 24. Tumor growth was monitored every 2–3 days using caliper measurements. Tumor volume was calculated as (length × width × height) × π/6. A549 Spheroid Invasion Assays Non-infected or infected (H3N2, MOI = 1) spheroids of 200 cells (A549) were formed in U- bottom ultra-low attachment (Thermo scientific, Nunclon Sphera, 174925) plates were and embedded in 2 mg/mL collagen I hydrogels (prepared from rat-tail collagen provided by C Helary, Laboratoire de Chimie de la Matière Condensee de Paris, Sorbonne Universite, CNRS, Paris, France), and supplemented with 10x M199 medium (Sigma-Aldrich, Saint-Louis MO, USA). The collagen solution was buffered at pH 6.5 at 20°C using NaHCOO3. Embedded spheroids were cultured for 2 days in FB96 phenoplates (Revvity, Waltham, MA, USA) in supplemented DMEM/F12 as previously described. Then, spheroids were stained with 10 phalloidin as described previously 20 and imaged using a spinning-disk confocal microscopy (Orion platform, College de France, Paris). Invasion was quantified using a custom ImageJ plugin developed by the Orion imaging platform. The plugin was based on a Sholl analysis, in which concentric circles are constructed around the spheroids and the number of nuclei and phalloidin-positive areas are quantified within each radial distance. Detection of IAV in A549 Spheroids A polyclonal anti-HA antibody (Invitrogen, PA5-34930) was conjugated to Alexa Fluor (AF) 488 (Invitrogen, A10235) and validated by flow cytometry. Spheroids were fixed in 4% paraformaldehyde for 30 min, permeabilized with PBS-Triton 0.5% for 30 min at room temperature and stained with phalloidin conjugated to AF-555 (Invitrogen, A34055; 1:200) and anti-HA-AF488 antibody (1:50) overnight at 4°C. Spheroids were then embedded in 1% low- melting agarose, cleared overnight in RapiClear 1.52 (Sunjin Lab, RC152001), and imaged using spinning-disk confocal microscopy (Orion platform, College de France, Paris). Images were analyzed using ImageJ. Transcriptomic Analyses of NSCLC Cohorts Gene expression (log-transformed FPKM) and clinical data from the TCGA LUAD cohort (n = 473) were downloaded from the Genomic Data Commons portal (https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/). Differentially expressed genes were identified using Wilcoxon rank-sum tests. Fold-changes were obtained from log-transformed expression values as differences in median expression between groups. Bulk RNA-seq datasets from two independent NSCLC cohorts, Onco-Cochin 21 and Onco-HEGP 22, were analyzed as validation cohorts. These cohorts included patients treated with perioperative chemotherapy (neo-adjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy in the Onco-HEGP cohort and neoadjuvant chemotherapy in the Onco-Cochin cohort). Differentially expressed genes were identified using the package DESeq2 and normalized gene expression matrices were obtained using the VST method. Associated 11 clinical annotations were obtained from the corresponding studies. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) was performed using the clusterProfiler package with KEGG and GO databases or custom signatures. Immune cell deconvolution was performed…

The research identifies a respiratory virus-associated drug metabolism program (REVIS-DM) linked to poor clinical outcomes in NSCLC. papers.source_body_en: Respiratory viral infections are frequent in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), yet whether intratumoral viral presence directly influences tumor behavior and therapeutic response remains unknown. Here, we identify a respiratory virus-associated drug metabolism program (REVIS-DM), predominantly expressed by tumor cells and linked to poor clinical outcome. Across multiple NSCLC cohorts, a subgroup of tumors with concurrent high REVIS-DM, interferon-stimulated gene and antiviral signatures was associated with reduced survival and increased relapse after chemotherapy. Consistent with this antiviral profile, Influenza A virus (IAV) transcripts were detected in NSCLC and associated with poor outcome and relapse. Mechanistically, IAV infection induced xenobiotic detoxification, epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, invasion, and platinum resistance in vitro and in vivo. These effects required viral sensing and NLRP3 inflammasome signaling but were independent of type I/III interferon pathways. Together, our findings establish intratumoral IAV infection as a previously unrecognized driver of tumor-cell plasticity and chemoresistance in NSCLC, revealing virus-induced metabolic vulnerabilities with potential therapeutic relevance.

papers.title: Red Pitahaya Betacyanins Selectively Upregulate Proinflammatory Cytokines In Vitro During Influenza A Virus Infection.
papers.abstract: Among the four influenza types, Influenza A virus (IAV) is responsible for annual epidemics and pandemics, causing the most severe illnesses, resulting in patient hospitalizations or death. With IAV threatening the next global influenza pandemic, it is a race against time to search for antiviral drugs. Betacyanins are reddish-violet, unique water-soluble nitrogen-containing pigments that have previously been reported to possess antiviral effects against IAV. The objectives of this study were to study interactions between betacyanins and key inflammatory markers, such as interleukin (IL)-1 β , IL-6, tumor necrosis factor (TNF)- α , and suppressor of cytokine signaling 3 (SOCS3), in IAV-infected A549 cells. Betacyanins were first extracted from red pitahaya, quantified, and characterized. A549 cells were infected with IAV and then treated with betacyanins. Quantitative PCR was performed to study the change in expression levels of IL-1 β , IL-6, TNF- α , and SOCS3. Molecular docking was performed to study any interactions between betacyanins and IL-1 β , IL-6, TNF- α , SOCS3, and their respective receptors, namely, IL-1R1, IL-6R, and TNFR1. Betacyanins modulated IL-1 β , IL-6, and TNF- α uniquely after up to 72 h. Specifically, both IL-1 β and IL-6 were significantly downregulated after 48 and 72 h, and TNF- α was significantly downregulated after 48 h. Additionally, SOCS3, a host factor that IAV hijacks and induces to promote its own survival, was downregulated after 48 and 72 h. In silico analysis showed that betacyanins such as phyllocactin, hylocerenin, betanin, and isobetanin formed binding interactions and hydrogen bonds with IL-1 β , IL-6, TNF- α , SOCS3, IL-1R1, IL-6R, and TNFR1. This study suggests that novel interactions between betacyanins and inflammatory cytokines might contribute to the antiviral effects of betacyanins, leading to the survival of the host cell. Future studies into the immunological aspects of the cell and overall cellular health are recommended.

papers.title_zh: 红火龙果甜菜苷在甲型流感病毒感染期间选择性上调体外促炎细胞因子。
papers.source_body_en: Among the four influenza types, Influenza A virus (IAV) is responsible for annual epidemics and pandemics, causing the most severe illnesses, resulting in patient hospitalizations or death. With IAV threatening the next global influenza pandemic, it is a race against time to search for antiviral drugs. Betacyanins are reddish-violet, unique water-soluble nitrogen-containing pigments that have previously been reported to possess antiviral effects against IAV. The objectives of this study were to study interactions between betacyanins and key inflammatory markers, such as interleukin (IL)-1 β , IL-6, tumor necrosis factor (TNF)- α , and suppressor of cytokine signaling 3 (SOCS3), in IAV-infected A549 cells. Betacyanins were first extracted from red pitahaya, quantified, and characterized. A549 cells were infected with IAV and then treated with betacyanins. Quantitative PCR was performed to study the change in expression levels of IL-1 β , IL-6, TNF- α , and SOCS3. Molecular docking was performed to study any interactions between betacyanins and IL-1 β , IL-6, TNF- α , SOCS3, and their respective receptors, namely, IL-1R1, IL-6R, and TNFR1. Betacyanins modulated IL-1 β , IL-6, and TNF- α uniquely after up to 72 h. Specifically, both IL-1 β and IL-6 were significantly downregulated after 48 and 72 h, and TNF- α was significantly downregulated after 48 h. Additionally, SOCS3, a host factor that IAV hijacks and induces to promote its own survival, was downregulated after 48 and 72 h. In silico analysis showed that betacyanins such as phyllocactin, hylocerenin, betanin, and isobetanin formed binding interactions and hydrogen bonds with IL-1 β , IL-6, TNF- α , SOCS3, IL-1R1, IL-6R, and TNFR1. This study suggests that novel interactions between betacyanins and inflammatory cytokines might contribute to the antiviral effects of betacyanins, leading to the survival of the host cell. Future studies into the immunological aspects of the cell and overall cellular health are recommended.
papers.abstract_zh: 在四种流感类型中,甲型流感病毒(IAV)每年都会流行和大流行,引起最严重的疾病,导致患者住院或死亡。随着 IAV 威胁下一次全球流感大流行,寻找 抗病毒药物 药物是一场与时间的赛跑。甜菜青苷是一种红紫色、独特的水溶性含氮色素,此前曾有报道称其具有 抗病毒药物 抗 IAV 作用。本研究的目的是研究 IAV 感染的 A549 细胞中甜菜青素与关键炎症标志物之间的相互作用,例如白细胞介素 (IL)-1 β、IL-6、肿瘤坏死因子 (TNF)-α 和细胞因子信号传导抑制因子 3 (SOCS3)。首先从红火龙果中提取甜菜青苷,并对其进行定量和表征。A549 细胞被 IAV 感染,然后用甜菜苷处理。进行定量PCR来研究IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α和SOCS3表达水平的变化。进行分子对接以研究甜菜花青素与 IL-1 β、IL-6、TNF-α、SOCS3 及其各自受体(即 IL-1R1、IL-6R 和 TNFR1)之间的相互作用。甜菜青素在长达 72 小时后独特地调节 IL-1 β、IL-6 和 TNF-α。具体而言,IL-1β和IL-6在48和72小时后均显着下调,TNF-α在48小时后显着下调。此外,SOCS3(IAV 劫持并诱导以促进其自身生存的 宿主 因子)在 48 小时和 72 小时后下调。计算机分析表明,甜菜青素(如叶菌素、hylocerenin、甜菜碱和异甜菜碱)与 IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α、SOCS3、IL-1R1、IL-6R 和 TNFR1 形成结合相互作用和氢键。这项研究表明,β花青素和炎症细胞因子之间的新型相互作用可能有助于β花青素的 抗病毒药物 效应,从而导致 宿主 细胞的存活。建议未来对细胞的免疫学方面和整体细胞健康进行研究。

papers.title: Zoonotic infections and genomic evolution of novel reassortant swine influenza A viruses in Spain
papers.abstract: Abstract Influenza A virus (IAV) circulates widely in European pig populations and continues to diversify through frequent introductions from humans, followed by reassortment within swine. Spain represents a particularly dynamic ecological setting due to the coexistence of intensive white-pig production, extensive Iberian-pig systems, and abundant wild boar populations. This study provides an integrated analysis of IAV evolution and genomic diversity in swine in Spain between 2019 and 2022, expanding on previous surveillance from 2016 to 2019. Sampling across 24 provinces yielded 66 new whole-genome sequences from Iberian and white pigs. We identified 18 genotypes, including 11 novel reassortants not detected in our previous survey. Several genotypes, such as H1N2 G21 and G22, H3N2 G23, and the unusual H3N1 G12, were exclusive to the country. Some genotypes were detected across white pigs, Iberian pigs, and wild boar in Toledo and Badajoz, suggesting viral flow among swine populations. Phylogenetic analyses revealed ongoing introductions of H1N1pdm09 from humans into pigs, generating at least five reassortant genotypes (G10, G16–G19). These lineages incorporated pandemic internal cassettes and, in some cases, human-seasonal N2 segments, highlighting the continued role of humans as a source of viral incursions. Conversely, four zoonotic infections (H1N1v) detected in Spain between 2022 and 2026 were linked to genotypes circulating in white pigs, underscoring the bidirectional nature of IAV transmission at the human swine interface. Overall, this study demonstrates that Spain provides ecological conditions conducive to IAV diversification, reassortment, and zoonotic risk. The findings reinforce the need for sustained One Health surveillance.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 甲型流感病毒(IAV)在欧洲猪群中广泛传播,并通过频繁地从人类引入以及随后在猪体内的重配而继续多样化。由于集约化的白猪生产、广泛的伊比利亚猪系统和丰富的野猪种群并存,西班牙代表了一个特别活跃的生态环境。本研究对 2019 年至 2022 年间西班牙猪的 IAV 进化 和基因组多样性进行了综合分析,扩展了 2016 年至 2019 年之前的 监测。在 24 个省进行采样,产生了来自伊比利亚猪和白猪的 66 个新的全 基因组 序列。我们鉴定了 18 种基因型,包括我们之前的调查中未检测到的 11 种新型重配体。几种基因型,如 H1N2 G21 和 G22、H3N2 G23 以及不寻常的 H3N1 G12 是该国独有的。在托莱多和巴达霍斯的白猪、伊比利亚猪和野猪中检测到了一些基因型,表明病毒在猪群中流动。系统发育分析显示,H1N1pdm09 病毒持续从人类传入猪体内,产生至少五种重配基因型(G10、G16-G19)。这些谱系包含大流行的内部基因盒,在某些情况下,还包含人类季节性的 N2 片段,强调了人类作为病毒入侵来源的持续作用。相反,2022 年至 2026 年间在西班牙检测到的四例人畜共患感染 (H1N1v) 与白猪中传播的基因型有关,这强调了 IAV 传播 在人猪界面上的双向性质。总体而言,这项研究表明西班牙提供了有利于 IAV 多样化、重组和人畜共患病风险的生态条件。研究结果强化了持续的 One Health 监测 的必要性。

papers.title: Synchronous co-infection drives lineage representation in influenza A virus populations
papers.abstract: Abstract RNA viruses evolve through replication errors that generate diversity but can also trigger cellular antiviral responses, creating an inherent tension between adaptation and host control. Influenza A virus biology adds to this complexity through genome segmentation, which enables reassortment but also creates infection heterogeneity through incomplete genome expression and packaging defects, and through superinfection exclusion, which restricts complementation. Together, these constraints would be expected to limit the consistent expansion of individual variants, yet the influenza A virus continues to adapt in nature, suggesting that specific infection contexts may allow disproportionate lineage amplification. To identify such contexts, we paired in vitro single-cell transcriptomics with viral lineage tracking to link infected cellular environments to viral output dynamics. We find that lineage enrichment predominantly occurs during synchronous coinfection, when multiple viral genomes occupy the same cell, and viral output is increased. These findings identify a timing-dependent condition under which lineage representation can shift, and predict that traits increasing burst output or the likelihood of synchronous coinfection may disproportionately shape population composition.

papers.title: Opposing cell-type preferences for binding and replication shape influenza A virus infection in human airways.
papers.abstract: Influenza A viruses (IAVs) pose a threat to human health. Although receptor specificity, polymerase adaptation, and airway tropism have been studied extensively, it remains unresolved how they combine to shape tropism in airway epithelia. Here, we show that avian IAVs infect ciliated and secretory cells but preferentially bind to ciliated cells because of higher apical α2,3-linked sialic acid levels. As replication levels are comparable between cell types, this translates into overall preference for ciliated cells. Human IAVs also preferentially bind to ciliated cells despite comparable α2,6-linked sialic acid abundance. Instead, they show higher viral RNA and protein levels in secretory cells, linked to their compatibility with human ANP32 proteins and modestly higher ANP32A/B expression in this cell type, resulting in equal infection levels across cell types. Our findings redefine IAV tropism in the human airway as a stage-resolved process shaped by the interplay between apical glycans, viral binding, polymerase cofactor compatibility, and cell-type-specific replication capacity, moving beyond receptor-centric models.

papers.title_zh: 细胞类型对结合和复制的相反偏好塑造了甲型流感病毒在人类呼吸道中的感染。
papers.source_body_en: Influenza A viruses (IAVs) pose a threat to human health. Although receptor specificity, polymerase adaptation, and airway tropism have been studied extensively, it remains unresolved how they combine to shape tropism in airway epithelia. Here, we show that avian IAVs infect ciliated and secretory cells but preferentially bind to ciliated cells because of higher apical α2,3-linked sialic acid levels. As replication levels are comparable between cell types, this translates into overall preference for ciliated cells. Human IAVs also preferentially bind to ciliated cells despite comparable α2,6-linked sialic acid abundance. Instead, they show higher viral RNA and protein levels in secretory cells, linked to their compatibility with human ANP32 proteins and modestly higher ANP32A/B expression in this cell type, resulting in equal infection levels across cell types. Our findings redefine IAV tropism in the human airway as a stage-resolved process shaped by the interplay between apical glycans, viral binding, polymerase cofactor compatibility, and cell-type-specific replication capacity, moving beyond receptor-centric models.
papers.abstract_zh: 甲型流感病毒(IAV)对人类健康构成威胁。尽管受体特异性、聚合酶适应性和气道向性已被广泛研究,但它们如何结合形成气道上皮细胞的向性仍悬而未决。在这里,我们发现禽类 IAV 感染纤毛细胞和分泌细胞,但由于顶端 α2,3 连接的唾液酸水平较高,优先与纤毛细胞结合。由于细胞类型之间的复制水平相当,这转化为对纤毛细胞的总体偏好。尽管 α2,6 连接的唾液酸丰度相当,但人类 IAV 也优先与纤毛细胞结合。相反,它们在分泌细胞中表现出更高的病毒RNA和蛋白质水平,这与它们与人类ANP32蛋白的相容性以及该细胞类型中较高的ANP32A/B表达有关,从而导致不同细胞类型的感染水平相同。我们的研究结果将人类气道中的 IAV 向性重新定义为一个阶段性解决的过程,由顶端聚糖、病毒结合、聚合酶辅因子兼容性和细胞类型特异性复制能力之间的相互作用形成,超越了以受体为中心的模型。

papers.title: Pulmonary infection caused by Nocardia cyriacigeorgica and influenza A virus coinfection in an immunocompetent patient
papers.abstract: Rationale: Pulmonary nocardiosis (PN) is an opportunistic infection caused by Nocardia species. It is characterized by a lack of specificity in both clinical symptoms and imaging findings. Most cases occur in individuals with compromised immune systems or underlying pulmonary diseases. In contrast, our patient did not present with any of these risk factors. Patient concerns: A 60-year-old immunocompetent male was admitted with a 5-month history of recurrent cough and expectoration. His respiratory symptoms worsened, and he developed a fever 9 days prior to hospitalization. Diagnoses: Nocardia cyriacigeorgica was identified in the sputum culture, as well as in the targeted next-generation sequencing and culture of the bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, while influenza A virus was detected by nucleic acid detection. Interventions: Along with antiviral therapy with peramivir, a combination antibiotic regimen of trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (TMP-SMX), etimicin, and meropenem was administered during hospitalization. Following discharge, oral TMP-SMX was continued as maintenance therapy. Outcomes: Regular follow-ups with the patient revealed that subsequent chest computed tomography (CT) scans showed a gradual reduction in the extent of the lesions, and the patient demonstrated a good clinical response and radiological improvement. Lessons: This case highlights the diagnostic complexity of PN. The radiological manifestations are diverse, commonly including pulmonary consolidation, nodules, and cavities, making it difficult to differentiate from other diseases. Early, precise diagnosis and prompt combined therapy are of vital importance in severe Nocardia pulmonary infection.

papers.title_zh: 免疫功能正常患者诺卡氏菌与甲型流感病毒合并感染所致肺部感染
papers.source_body_en: Rationale: Pulmonary nocardiosis (PN) is an opportunistic infection caused by Nocardia species. It is characterized by a lack of specificity in both clinical symptoms and imaging findings. Most cases occur in individuals with compromised immune systems or underlying pulmonary diseases. In contrast, our patient did not present with any of these risk factors. Patient concerns: A 60-year-old immunocompetent male was admitted with a 5-month history of recurrent cough and expectoration. His respiratory symptoms worsened, and he developed a fever 9 days prior to hospitalization. Diagnoses: Nocardia cyriacigeorgica was identified in the sputum culture, as well as in the targeted next-generation sequencing and culture of the bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, while influenza A virus was detected by nucleic acid detection. Interventions: Along with antiviral therapy with peramivir, a combination antibiotic regimen of trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (TMP-SMX), etimicin, and meropenem was administered during hospitalization. Following discharge, oral TMP-SMX was continued as maintenance therapy. Outcomes: Regular follow-ups with the patient revealed that subsequent chest computed tomography (CT) scans showed a gradual reduction in the extent of the lesions, and the patient demonstrated a good clinical response and radiological improvement. Lessons: This case highlights the diagnostic complexity of PN. The radiological manifestations are diverse, commonly including pulmonary consolidation, nodules, and cavities, making it difficult to differentiate from other diseases. Early, precise diagnosis and prompt combined therapy are of vital importance in severe Nocardia pulmonary infection.
papers.abstract_zh: 基本原理:肺诺卡氏菌病(PN)是由诺卡氏菌引起的机会性感染。其特点是临床症状和影像学表现缺乏特异性。大多数病例发生在免疫系统受损或患有潜在肺部疾病的个体中。相比之下,我们的患者没有出现任何这些危险因素。患者担忧:一名 60 岁免疫功能正常的男性入院,有 5 个月的反复咳嗽和咳痰病史。他的呼吸道症状恶化,入院前 9 天出现发烧症状。诊断:痰培养、支气管肺泡灌洗液二代靶向测序和培养中检出诺卡氏菌,核酸检测检出甲型流感病毒。干预措施:在住院期间,除了采用帕拉米韦 抗病毒药物 治疗外,还给予甲氧苄啶-磺胺甲恶唑 (TMP-SMX)、依替米星和美罗培南的联合抗生素治疗方案。出院后,继续口服 TMP-SMX 作为维持治疗。结果:对患者的定期随访显示,随后的胸部计算机断层扫描(CT)扫描显示病变范围逐渐缩小​​,患者表现出良好的临床反应和放射学改善。经验教训:该病例凸显了 PN 诊断的复杂性。放射学表现多样,常见包括肺实变、结节、空洞等,难以与其他疾病鉴别。早期、精准的诊断和及时的联合治疗对于重症诺卡氏菌肺部感染至关重要。

papers.title: Investigating the evolutionary plasticity of influenza virus splicing using influenza A virus segment 7 as a model system
papers.abstract: Influenza viruses A, C and D (IAV, ICV, IDV respectively) utilise mRNA splicing to produce two proteins from their matrix gene segment; the matrix (M1) protein and an ion channel (M2). In IAV, the M1 and M2 open reading frames (ORFs) partially overlap and splice donor (SD) and splice acceptor (SA) sites in the M1 gene are used to produce an M2 polypeptide with an N-terminal sequence shared with M1. In ICV and IDV, the M1 and M2 ORFs are concatenated and splice sites downstream of the M1 coding region are used to produce a matrix protein from the spliced mRNA. To probe how these different splicing strategies might have evolved, we used reverse genetics to test the evolutionary flexibility of IAV SD and SA sites. We found that relatively small numbers of mutations were sufficient to activate a variety of alternative SD and SA sites in a mini-replicon system, several of which led to the production of ion channel isoforms with variant ectodomains, as well as one that produced an M1 variant. Furthermore, several of the viruses with altered splicing patterns were viable, including five with both SD and SA sites changed. Three of these 'rewired' viruses had only modest fitness penalties, despite up to 3 nonsynonymous changes in M1 and a 34 amino acid insertion in M2. These results suggest that IAV segment 7 splicing strategies are evolutionarily flexible and have implications for how IAV, ICV and IDV matrix segments might have diversified from a common ancestor.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the evolutionary plasticity of influenza virus splicing, particularly focusing on how different splicing strategies might have evolved across influenza A, B, and C viruses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used reverse genetics to test the evolutionary flexibility of IAV SD and SA sites, employing a mini-replicon system to examine the effects of mutations on splicing patterns.
analysis.methods: The researchers utilized reverse genetics to introduce mutations into the SD and SA sites of the IAV segment 7 and assessed the resulting splicing patterns and viral viability in a mini-replicon system.
analysis.main_results: Relatively small numbers of mutations were sufficient to activate alternative SD and SA sites, leading to the production of ion channel isoforms with variant ectodomains and an M1 variant. Several viruses with altered splicing patterns were viable, including five with both SD and SA sites changed.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that IAV segment 7 splicing strategies are evolutionarily flexible, providing insights into how IAV, ICV, and IDV matrix segments might have diversified from a common ancestor.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results have implications for understanding the evolutionary mechanisms of influenza viruses, which could inform surveillance, diagnosis, and the development of antiviral strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a mini-replicon system, which may not fully represent the complexity of whole-virus behavior. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on in vitro experiments and not in vivo validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the evolutionary plasticity of influenza virus splicing, focusing on the matrix gene segment of influenza A virus (IAV). Using reverse genetics, the researchers tested the flexibility of splicing donor (SD) and acceptor (SA) sites in IAV and found that small mutations could activate alternative splicing patterns, producing ion channel isoforms with variant ectodomains and an M1 variant. Several of these altered viruses remained viable, indicating the potential for evolutionary adaptation. The results suggest that IAV splicing strategies are flexible, offering insights into the diversification of matrix segments across influenza A, B, and C viruses. However, the study's reliance on a mini-replicon system limits its applicability to whole-virus behavior, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在研究流感病毒剪接的进化可塑性,特别关注不同的剪接策略如何在甲型、乙型和丙型流感病毒中进化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用反向遗传学来测试IAV SD和SA位点的进化灵活性,采用微型复制子系统来检查突变对剪接模式的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员利用反向遗传学将 突变 引入 IAV 片段 7 的 SD 和 SA 位点,并评估了微型复制子系统中由此产生的剪接模式和病毒活力。
elements_zh.main_results: 相对少量的 突变 足以激活替代的 SD 和 SA 位点,导致产生具有变体胞外域和 M1 变体的离子通道亚型。几种剪接模式改变的病毒是可行的,其中包括五种 SD 和 SA 位点均发生改变的病毒。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,IAV 片段 7 剪接策略在进化上是灵活的,这为了解 IAV、ICV 和 IDV 矩阵片段如何从共同祖先中多样化提供了见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对于理解流感病毒的进化机制具有重要意义,这可以为 监测、诊断 和 抗病毒药物 策略的开发提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于微型复制子系统,可能无法完全代表整个病毒行为的复杂性。证据是中等的,因为这些发现是基于体外实验而不是体内验证。

papers.title_zh: 使用甲型流感病毒片段 7 作为模型系统研究流感病毒剪接的进化可塑性
papers.source_body_en: Influenza viruses A, C and D (IAV, ICV, IDV respectively) utilise mRNA splicing to produce two proteins from their matrix gene segment; the matrix (M1) protein and an ion channel (M2). In IAV, the M1 and M2 open reading frames (ORFs) partially overlap and splice donor (SD) and splice acceptor (SA) sites in the M1 gene are used to produce an M2 polypeptide with an N-terminal sequence shared with M1. In ICV and IDV, the M1 and M2 ORFs are concatenated and splice sites downstream of the M1 coding region are used to produce a matrix protein from the spliced mRNA. To probe how these different splicing strategies might have evolved, we used reverse genetics to test the evolutionary flexibility of IAV SD and SA sites. We found that relatively small numbers of mutations were sufficient to activate a variety of alternative SD and SA sites in a mini-replicon system, several of which led to the production of ion channel isoforms with variant ectodomains, as well as one that produced an M1 variant. Furthermore, several of the viruses with altered splicing patterns were viable, including five with both SD and SA sites changed. Three of these 'rewired' viruses had only modest fitness penalties, despite up to 3 nonsynonymous changes in M1 and a 34 amino acid insertion in M2. These results suggest that IAV segment 7 splicing strategies are evolutionarily flexible and have implications for how IAV, ICV and IDV matrix segments might have diversified from a common ancestor.

papers.title: TLR7 Deficiency Reveals Compartment-Specific Respiratory–Systemic Immune Responses During Severe Influenza A Virus Infection
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) infection can progress from a localized respiratory illness to severe disease characterized by pulmonary inflammation, systemic cytokinemia, acute-phase responses and multi-organ pathology. Toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7) is a key sensor of viral single-stranded RNA and an important component of antiviral immunity; however, its role in extending immunity from the respiratory tract to peripheral compartments during severe IAV infection remains incompletely understood. Here, we investigated the relationship between TLR7 and innate, cellular and humoral immune responses across respiratory and peripheral compartments during IAV infection. Using TLR7-deficient mice infected with the highly pathogenic PR8 H1N1 strain, we profiled immune responses in nasal tissue, bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, lung, blood and spleen, together with cytokine production, C-reactive protein levels, T cell activation and antibody isotype responses. Loss of TLR7 was accompanied by compartment-specific alterations in innate immunity, including differences in pulmonary macrophage and dendritic cell responses, and altered plasmacytoid dendritic cell distribution across respiratory and peripheral compartments. Reduced virus-specific CD8+ T cell expansion, lower IFNγ and TNFα production by T cells, and diminished circulating inflammatory cytokines and C-reactive protein were also observed. In parallel, altered humoral responses included reduced mucosal IgA, systemic IgM and Th1-associated IgG2a responses, together with changes in antibody isotype distribution. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that TLR7 deficiency is associated with broad, compartment-specific alterations in innate and adaptive immune responses during established IAV infection, extending across the respiratory tract, blood and spleen and correlating with disease severity. These findings support a role for TLR7-associated signaling in shaping the broader respiratory–systemic immune response, with its presence linked to both antiviral immune engagement and the magnitude of systemic inflammation during severe IAV infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查严重甲型流感病毒(IAV)感染期间TLR7在将免疫力从呼吸道扩展到外周区室中的作用,解决IAV感染期间TLR7和免疫应答在呼吸道和外周区室之间不完全了解的关系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用感染高致病性 PR8 H1N1 毒株的 TLR7 缺陷小鼠来分析鼻组织、支气管肺泡灌洗液、肺、血液和脾脏中的 免疫应答,以及细胞因子的产生、C 反应蛋白水平、T 细胞激活和抗体同种型反应。
elements_zh.methods: TLR7 缺陷型小鼠感染 PR8 H1N1 病毒株,并利用细胞因子产生、C 反应蛋白水平、T 细胞激活和抗体同种型反应,对鼻组织、支气管肺泡灌洗液、肺、血液和脾脏等不同部位的 免疫应答 进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: TLR7 缺陷与先天免疫的区室特异性改变有关,包括肺巨噬细胞和树突状细胞反应的差异,以及呼吸和外周区室中浆细胞样树突细胞分布的改变。此外,还观察到病毒特异性 CD8+ T 细胞扩增减少、T 细胞产生的 IFNγ 和 TNFα 降低、循环炎症细胞因子和 C 反应蛋白减少。体液反应还包括粘膜 IgA、全身 IgM 和 Th1 相关 IgG2a 反应减少,以及抗体同种型分布的变化。

papers.title_zh: TLR7 缺陷揭示了严重甲型流感病毒感染期间特定的呼吸系统 免疫应答
papers.source_body_en: Influenza A virus (IAV) infection can progress from a localized respiratory illness to severe disease characterized by pulmonary inflammation, systemic cytokinemia, acute-phase responses and multi-organ pathology. Toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7) is a key sensor of viral single-stranded RNA and an important component of antiviral immunity; however, its role in extending immunity from the respiratory tract to peripheral compartments during severe IAV infection remains incompletely understood. Here, we investigated the relationship between TLR7 and innate, cellular and humoral immune responses across respiratory and peripheral compartments during IAV infection. Using TLR7-deficient mice infected with the highly pathogenic PR8 H1N1 strain, we profiled immune responses in nasal tissue, bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, lung, blood and spleen, together with cytokine production, C-reactive protein levels, T cell activation and antibody isotype responses. Loss of TLR7 was accompanied by compartment-specific alterations in innate immunity, including differences in pulmonary macrophage and dendritic cell responses, and altered plasmacytoid dendritic cell distribution across respiratory and peripheral compartments. Reduced virus-specific CD8+ T cell expansion, lower IFNγ and TNFα production by T cells, and diminished circulating inflammatory cytokines and C-reactive protein were also observed. In parallel, altered humoral responses included reduced mucosal IgA, systemic IgM and Th1-associated IgG2a responses, together with changes in antibody isotype distribution. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that TLR7 deficiency is associated with broad, compartment-specific alterations in innate and adaptive immune responses during established IAV infection, extending across the respiratory tract, blood and spleen and correlating with disease severity. These findings support a role for TLR7-associated signaling in shaping the broader respiratory–systemic immune response, with its presence linked to both antiviral immune engagement and the magnitude of systemic inflammation during severe IAV infection.
papers.abstract_zh: 甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 感染可从局部呼吸道疾病发展为以肺部炎症、全身细胞因子血症、急性期反应和多器官病理为特征的严重疾病。Toll样受体7(TLR7)是病毒单链RNA的关键传感器,也是抗病毒药物免疫的重要组成部分;然而,在严重 IAV 感染期间,其在将免疫力从呼吸道扩展到外周区室中的作用仍不完全清楚。在这里,我们研究了 IAV 感染期间 TLR7 与呼吸和外周区室的先天、细胞和体液 免疫应答 之间的关系。使用感染高致病性 PR8 H1N1 毒株的 TLR7 缺陷小鼠,我们分析了鼻组织、支气管肺泡灌洗液、肺、血液和脾脏中的 免疫应答,以及细胞因子的产生、C 反应蛋白水平、T 细胞激活和抗体同种型反应。TLR7的缺失伴随着先天免疫的区室特异性改变,包括肺巨噬细胞和树突状细胞反应的差异,以及呼吸和外周区室中浆细胞样树突细胞分布的改变。还观察到病毒特异性 CD8+ T 细胞扩增减少、T 细胞产生的 IFNγ 和 TNFα 降低、循环炎症细胞因子和 C 反应蛋白减少。与此同时,体液反应的改变包括粘膜 IgA、全身 IgM 和 Th1 相关 IgG2a 反应的减少,以及抗体同种型分布的变化。总的来说,这些发现表明,TLR7 缺陷与 IAV 感染期间先天性和适应性 免疫应答 的广泛的、区室特异性的改变有关,这种改变延伸到呼吸道、血液和脾脏,并与疾病的严重程度相关。这些发现支持 TLR7 相关信号在塑造更广泛的呼吸系统 免疫应答 中的作用,其存在与 抗病毒药物 免疫参与和严重 IAV 感染期间全身炎症的严重程度有关。

papers.title: Circular RNA MARCH3 promotes influenza A virus replication by coordinating NF-κB negative feedback and the miR-3657/ATG7 axis
papers.abstract: Introduction Circular RNAs (circRNAs) have emerged as important regulators of diverse cellular processes, and accumulating evidence indicates that certain circRNAs modulate immune responses through complex mechanisms. However, their roles in innate immunity against influenza A virus (IAV) infection remain poorly understood. Methods We identified a previously uncharacterized circRNA, termed circMARCH3, through RNA-seq, RNase R digestion assay, and RNA stability assay. We examined circMARCH3 expression in multiple cell types following viral infection by RT-PCR and real-time PCR, investigated the signaling pathway driving its induction, and performed functional analyses using circMARCH3 overexpression vectors and shRNAs-mediated knockdown. Furthermore, we identified and validated the circMARCH3/miR-3657/ATG7 axis through mechanistic studies. Results circMARCH3 is generated from the pre-mRNA of the membrane-associated RING-CH-Type Finger 3 (MARCH3) gene, and its expression was robustly induced by IAV and several other viral infections in multiple cell types. Mechanistically, virus-induced circMARCH3 expression was driven by the NF-κB signaling pathway. Functional analyses demonstrated that circMARCH3 overexpression significantly promoted IAV replication, whereas circMARCH3 knockdown markedly inhibited viral production. Consistent with these findings, circMARCH3 functioned as a negative regulator of antiviral innate immunity by attenuating NF-κB activation and type I interferon responses. Furthermore, we identified that circMARCH3 targeted miR-3657, a microRNA that suppresses the expression of ATG7, a key autophagy regulator and known pro-IAV factor. Mechanistic studies revealed that circMARCH3 acted as a competitive endogenous RNA (ceRNA), sequestering miR-3657 and thereby relieving its repressive effect on ATG7 expression, resulting in enhanced autophagy and increased viral replication. Discussion The results demonstrate circMARCH3 as a virus-inducible circRNA that promotes IAV infection through two complementary mechanisms: dampening NF-κB-mediated antiviral innate immunity and facilitating autophagy via the circMARCH3/miR-3657/ATG7 axis. Our findings establish circMARCH3 as a novel regulator of the complex interaction between host and IAV by coordinating NF-κB negative feedback and the miR-3657/ATG7 axis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of circular RNAs (circRNAs) in modulating immune responses, particularly focusing on their potential involvement in innate immunity against influenza A virus (IAV) infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in multiple cell types, examining circMARCH3 expression following viral infection. It involved both circMARCH3 overexpression and knockdown experiments to assess its impact on IAV replication.
analysis.methods: circMARCH3 was identified through RNA-seq, RNase R digestion assay, and RNA stability assay. Its expression was analyzed in various cell types using RT-PCR and real-time PCR, and its functional role was investigated using overexpression vectors and shRNAs-mediated knockdown.
analysis.main_results: circMARCH3 is generated from the pre-mRNA of the MARCH3 gene and its expression was robustly induced by IAV and several other viral infections in multiple cell types. Functional analyses showed that circMARCH3 overexpression significantly promoted IAV replication, whereas knockdown markedly inhibited viral production.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The results demonstrate that circMARCH3 promotes IAV infection by dampening NF-κB-mediated antiviral innate immunity and facilitating autophagy through the circMARCH3/miR-3657/ATG7 axis. This establishes circMARCH3 as a novel regulator of host-virus interactions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of IAV replication and suggest potential targets for therapeutic interventions aimed at modulating host immune responses to influenza.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on cell culture models and the absence of in vivo validation. However, the evidence is strong due to the use of multiple experimental approaches to confirm circMARCH3's role in IAV infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the role of circMARCH3 in promoting influenza A virus (IAV) replication. It identifies circMARCH3 as a virus-inducible circular RNA that modulates host immune responses by dampening NF-κB-mediated antiviral innate immunity and enhancing autophagy through the circMARCH3/miR-3657/ATG7 axis. The research highlights circMARCH3 as a novel regulatory element in host-virus interactions, offering potential targets for therapeutic strategies. While the study is based on cell culture experiments, the findings are supported by multiple methods including RNA-seq, RT-PCR, and functional assays. The results contribute to understanding the complex interplay between host factors and IAV, with implications for future research on influenza pathogenesis and treatment.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of circular RNAs (circRNAs) in modulating immune responses, particularly focusing on their potential involvement in innate immunity against influenza A virus (IAV) infection.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in multiple cell types, examining circMARCH3 expression following viral infection. It involved both circMARCH3 overexpression and knockdown experiments to assess its impact on IAV replication.
elements_en.methods: circMARCH3 was identified through RNA-seq, RNase R digestion assay, and RNA stability assay. Its expression was analyzed in various cell types using RT-PCR and real-time PCR, and its functional role was investigated using overexpression vectors and shRNAs-mediated knockdown.
elements_en.main_results: circMARCH3 is generated from the pre-mRNA of the MARCH3 gene and its expression was robustly induced by IAV and several other viral infections in multiple cell types. Functional analyses showed that circMARCH3 overexpression significantly promoted IAV replication, whereas knockdown markedly inhibited viral production.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The results demonstrate that circMARCH3 promotes IAV infection by dampening NF-κB-mediated antiviral innate immunity and facilitating autophagy through the circMARCH3/miR-3657/ATG7 axis. This establishes circMARCH3 as a novel regulator of host-virus interactions.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of IAV replication and suggest potential targets for therapeutic interventions aimed at modulating host immune responses to influenza.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on cell culture models and the absence of in vivo validation. However, the evidence is strong due to the use of multiple experimental approaches to confirm circMARCH3's role in IAV infection.

papers.title_zh: 环状RNA MARCH3通过协调NF-κB负反馈和miR-3657/ATG7轴促进甲型流感病毒复制
papers.source_body_en: Introduction Circular RNAs (circRNAs) have emerged as important regulators of diverse cellular processes, and accumulating evidence indicates that certain circRNAs modulate immune responses through complex mechanisms. However, their roles in innate immunity against influenza A virus (IAV) infection remain poorly understood. Methods We identified a previously uncharacterized circRNA, termed circMARCH3, through RNA-seq, RNase R digestion assay, and RNA stability assay. We examined circMARCH3 expression in multiple cell types following viral infection by RT-PCR and real-time PCR, investigated the signaling pathway driving its induction, and performed functional analyses using circMARCH3 overexpression vectors and shRNAs-mediated knockdown. Furthermore, we identified and validated the circMARCH3/miR-3657/ATG7 axis through mechanistic studies. Results circMARCH3 is generated from the pre-mRNA of the membrane-associated RING-CH-Type Finger 3 (MARCH3) gene, and its expression was robustly induced by IAV and several other viral infections in multiple cell types. Mechanistically, virus-induced circMARCH3 expression was driven by the NF-κB signaling pathway. Functional analyses demonstrated that circMARCH3 overexpression significantly promoted IAV replication, whereas circMARCH3 knockdown markedly inhibited viral production. Consistent with these findings, circMARCH3 functioned as a negative regulator of antiviral innate immunity by attenuating NF-κB activation and type I interferon responses. Furthermore, we identified that circMARCH3 targeted miR-3657, a microRNA that suppresses the expression of ATG7, a key autophagy regulator and known pro-IAV factor. Mechanistic studies revealed that circMARCH3 acted as a competitive endogenous RNA (ceRNA), sequestering miR-3657 and thereby relieving its repressive effect on ATG7 expression, resulting in enhanced autophagy and increased viral replication. Discussion The results demonstrate circMARCH3 as a virus-inducible circRNA that promotes IAV infection through two complementary mechanisms: dampening NF-κB-mediated antiviral innate immunity and facilitating autophagy via the circMARCH3/miR-3657/ATG7 axis. Our findings establish circMARCH3 as a novel regulator of the complex interaction between host and IAV by coordinating NF-κB negative feedback and the miR-3657/ATG7 axis.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言 环状 RNA (circRNA) 已成为多种细胞过程的重要调节因子,越来越多的证据表明某些 circRNA 通过复杂的机制调节 免疫应答。然而,它们在针对甲型流感病毒(IAV)感染的先天免疫中的作用仍然知之甚少。方法我们通过 RNA-seq、RNase R 消化测定和 RNA 稳定性测定鉴定了一种先前未表征的 circRNA,称为 circMARCH3。我们通过 RT-PCR 和实时 PCR 检查了病毒感染后多种细胞类型中 circMARCH3 的表达,研究了驱动其诱导的信号通路,并使用 circMARCH3 过表达 媒介 和 shRNA 介导的敲低进行了功能分析。此外,我们通过机制研究鉴定并验证了 circMARCH3/miR-3657/ATG7 轴。结果 circMARCH3 由膜相关的 RING-CH-Type Finger 3 (MARCH3) 基因的前体 mRNA 生成,其表达在多种细胞类型中受到 IAV 和其他几种病毒感染的强烈诱导。从机制上讲,病毒诱导的 circMARCH3 表达是由 NF-κB 信号通路驱动的。功能分析表明,circMARCH3过表达显着促进IAV复制,而circMARCH3敲低则显着抑制病毒产生。与这些发现一致的是,circMARCH3 通过减弱 NF-κB 激活和 I 型干扰素反应,充当 抗病毒药物 先天免疫的负调节因子。此外,我们还发现 circMARCH3 靶向 miR-3657,这是一种抑制 ATG7 表达的 microRNA,ATG7 是一种关键的自噬调节因子和已知的 pro-IAV 因子。机制研究表明,circMARCH3 作为竞争性内源 RNA (ceRNA),隔离 miR-3657,从而缓解其对 ATG7 表达的抑制作用,从而增强自噬并增加病毒复制。讨论 结果表明,circMARCH3 作为病毒诱导型 circRNA,通过两种互补机制促进 IAV 感染:抑制 NF-κB 介导的 抗病毒药物 先天免疫和通过 circMARCH3/miR-3657/ATG7 轴促进自噬。我们的研究结果表明,circMARCH3 通过协调 NF-κB 负反馈和 miR-3657/ATG7 轴,成为 宿主 和 IAV 之间复杂相互作用的新型调节剂。

papers.title: การสอบสวนการระบาดโรคไขหวดใหญ สายพนธ A (H3N2) ของกลมคนพกพงใน สถานสงเคราะหแหงหนง จงหวดศรสะเกษ ประเทศไทย ระหวางเดอนมถนายน - กรกฎาคม 2568
papers.abstract: An influenza A (H3N2) outbreak investigation was conducted among residents and staff at a social welfare center in Khukhan District, Sisaket Province, between June and July 2025. The objectives were to confirm the diagnosis and epidemiology, the distribution characteristics, and to identify potential causes and risk factors to guide effective prevention and control measures. Descriptive epidemiology and a retrospective cohort study were utilized. Data and active cases were actively sought and collected using case investigation forms. Nasopharyngeal swabs were obtained for laboratory confirmation, and environmental assessments were performed. Results: Out of 317 residents and staff, 205 met the case definition, resulting in an attack rate of 64.67%. These cases comprised 13 confirmed, 10 probable, and 182 suspected cases. The majority were male (136 cases) and female (36 cases), with a male-to-female ratio of 1.97:1. The median age was 49 years (range: 20–78 years). The five most common clinical manifestations were cough (60.49%), fever (55.12%), rhinorrhea (43.41%), headache (37.07%), and sore throat (28.78%). Six deaths were reported, representing a mortality rate of 1.81%. Multivariate analysis revealed that significant risk factors associated with the infection included sleeping in close proximity (ORadj=1.92, 95% CI: 1.01-3.63), utilizing a communal bathtub on wet floors (ORadj=17.55, 95% CI: 8.94-34.46), sharing drinking cups (ORadj=3.42, 95% CI: 1.51-7.75), and dining in groups (ORadj=3.12, 95% CI: 1.46-6.69). This outbreak was caused by Influenza A (H3N2) virus. The outbreak was successfully contained and terminated following the implementation of strict control measures, including patient isolation, surface cleaning and disinfection, strict enforcement of mask-wearing and hand hygiene, chlorination of water for shelter use, and vaccination.
papers.journal: The Office of Disease Prevention and Control 10th Journal

papers.title: การสอบสวนการระบาดโรคไขหวดใหญชนด A สายพนธ H3N2 ในโรงเรยนแหงหนง อําเภอไพรบง จงหวดศรสะเกษ ระหวางวนท 13 กมภาพนธ - 3 มนาคม 2568
papers.abstract: An outbreak investigation of influenza was conducted in a school in Phrai Bueng District, Sisaket Province, during 13 February–3 March 2025. The objective were to confirm the diagnosis and the existence of the outbreak, characterize the magnitude of the problem and describe the distribution of cases by person, time, and place, identify the source of infection and modes of transmission, analyze risk factors among exposed individuals as well as protective factors and ultimately, to implement appropriate prevention and control measures. A descriptive epidemiological study was carried out by reviewing medical records and conducting active case finding through interviews with students and school staff. An analytical epidemiological study was performed to identify risk and protective factors among cases and controls. using a case–control study and Chi-square test, and Environmental assessment and laboratory investigations were also conducted. A total of 43 cases meeting the influenza case definition were identified, with an attack rate of 25.59%. The median age of cases was 11 years, and the male-to-female ratio was 1:1.38. Influenza A/B antigen rapid tests were positive for Influenza A in 3 cases, and real-time RT-PCR detected Influenza A/H3N2 viral RNA in 2 cases. A statistically significant protective factor was maintaining a distance of at least 1 meter between desks in classrooms (adj OR = 0.19, 95% CI: 0.06–0.58, p-value = 0.005). This study demonstrates that physical distancing, particularly in classroom settings, is an effective measure for reducing influenza transmission in schools. Following the implementation of control measures, the last case was reported on 25 February 2025, and no additional cases were identified during 7 days of continued surveillance.
papers.journal: The Office of Disease Prevention and Control 10th Journal
